insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Annual Sum Insured (exact amount not provided in shared pages; as per Policy Schedule). Also mentions Deductible-based Top-up/Super Top-up variants.

great.name: Built-in additional SI buffer (Reset Benefit)
great.quote: “Reset Benefit... We will reset up to 100% of the Sum insured once in a policy year... in case the Sum insured including accrued Loyalty Bonus(if any) is insufficient...”
great.explanation: Provides an extra buffer once the base Sum Insured is exhausted (subject to conditions). This improves claim-paying capacity within the same policy year.

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days)
good.quote: “Code- Excl03: 30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: PED waiting period (24 months)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy...”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is an industry-standard waiting period.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period (24 months)
good.quote: “Code- Excl02... listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Standard 24-month waiting for listed diseases/procedures (unless due to accident).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization expenses (60 days)
good.quote: “Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred by You up to 60-days immediately prior to Your Hospitalization”
good.explanation: Covers diagnostic/consultation expenses for up to 60 days before admission (subject to admissible hospitalization).

good.name: Post-hospitalization expenses (90 days)
good.quote: “Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred by You up to 90-days immediately post Hospitalization”
good.explanation: Covers follow-up medicines/tests for up to 90 days after discharge (subject to admissible hospitalization).

good.name: Co-pay for seniors (20% for 60+ only; with waiver condition)
good.quote: “We are not liable to pay twenty percent (20%) of admissible claim amount above the Deductible... for insured(s) above 60 years of age... However, this condition will not be applicable if You were aged 45 years or below at the time of buying this policy first time with Us and have renewed it continuously after that.”
good.explanation: Industry-standard senior-citizen co-pay (applies above age 60), with a favorable waiver if purchased early and renewed continuously.

bad.name: Room rent limit not stated (treated as not covered/unknown in wording extract)
bad.quote: “We will cover medical expenses for: • Hospital room rent”
bad.explanation: The document excerpt does not specify whether room rent is 'any room/no limit/single AC' etc. Since the limit is not provided here, it can materially impact claims (possible room category restriction and proportionate deductions in practice). Verify in Policy Schedule.

bad.name: Restore Benefit (mandatory feature) not available/ not stated
bad.quote: No clause found stating restore/reinstatement of Sum Insured (separate from Reset Benefit).
bad.explanation: No restore/reinstatement benefit is stated. Without restore, Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim (Reset exists but is restricted to unrelated illness and only for certain deductible plans).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (IRDAI non-payables list includes many consumables)
bad.quote: “Non Payables... List of Non Payable Items as per IRDAI... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK...”
bad.explanation: The policy explicitly lists many items (including gloves, masks, kits, etc.) as non-payable, leading to out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Reset Benefit restricted to unrelated illness only (same illness not allowed) and only for deductible ₹3L+ plans
bad.quote: “For plans with Deductible ₹ 3lacs and above... The reset amount can only be used for all future claims within the same policy year, not related to the illness/disease/injury for which a claim has been paid in that policy year for the same person”
bad.explanation: Reset is helpful but restricted: it does not apply to the same illness and is only available for plans with deductible ₹3 lakh and above.

bad.name: NCB/Renewal Bonus resets impact not clearly protected; Loyalty Bonus appears capped and likely claim-linked
bad.quote: “Loyalty Bonus... For each completed and continuous Policy Year subject to a maximum of 50% 10%” AND “our liability... shall not exceed the Annual Sum Insured (including Loyalty Bonus) ... based on Claim settled under the Policy.”
bad.reference: Section 2.A.9 (Page 10) and definition of Annual Sum Insured (Page 1)
bad.explanation: Loyalty Bonus is mentioned but there is no statement that it is protected/non-reducing on claims. Wording suggests Sum Insured may be revised based on claims, so the bonus may not be non-resetting. This is weaker than best-in-class renewal bonus designs.

bad.name: Excluded providers / delisted hospitals may restrict full claim payouts (only stabilization payable)
bad.quote: “Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital... specifically excluded by the Insurer... are not admissible. However, in case of life threatening situations or following an accident, expenses up to the stage of stabilization are payable but not the complete claim.”
bad.explanation: If treatment happens at a delisted/excluded provider, the claim may be denied beyond stabilization, creating a significant payout risk.

bad.name: Domiciliary hospitalization: many common conditions not covered under domiciliary benefit
bad.quote: “Domiciliary Hospitalisation benefits... shall not cover... Asthma... Bronchitis... Diabetes... Hypertension... Influenza, Cough and Cold... Arthritis, Gout and Rheumatism”
bad.explanation: While domiciliary hospitalization exists, it excludes many common chronic/respiratory conditions, limiting usefulness when home-care is medically necessary.

unclear.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (whether it resets to zero on claim) — not explicitly stated
unclear.quote: “Loyalty Bonus...” (no explicit statement found on whether it reduces/resets after claims or is added irrespective of claims)
unclear.explanation: The document does not clearly state how Loyalty Bonus behaves after a claim (reduction/reset/non-resetting). Confirm from Policy Schedule/bonus terms.

unclear.name: Cashless network size (hospital count) not specified
unclear.quote: “Cashless treatment is only available at a Network Provider (List of Network Provider is available at our website... )”
unclear.explanation: Network exists but the number of cashless hospitals is not stated in the wording excerpt. Verify current network size on insurer website.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
